title: Connect the lab to installed Python
summary: Fix Python execution when Windows app aliases are broken by resolving the installed Python interpreter for code runs and interactive terminals.

changes.detail: Shared Python resolver with Windows Python install-manager fallback and explicit executable override.
Code execution and terminal discovery now use the same real interpreter rather than a broken Windows shortcut.
Python regression test exercises automatic runtime discovery.

validation.name: Validation pending
validation.detail: Installed Python 3.14.6 was identified; runtime regression checks and app typecheck have not run yet. No deployment or phone validation.
